defects.title: kode-cli reports a requested re-run of make/./app as successful by re-quoting earlier output without executing any tool call in that turn.
defects.expected_behavior: When the user asks to run make / ./app (again), execute the command in that turn and report its real output; if it was not run, say so.
defects.observed_behavior: Reproduced in 2 of 2 rounds on source ed7b81a7a139. R1 step-4 asked to run make and capture the output: kode-cli only read main.c and Makefile and presented the earlier 'rm -f app / gcc -Wall -Werror -o app main.c' output as the make result. R2 step-8 asked to run ./app: no tool call, and the reply reported './app output: 5' from the previous step's run. In other steps the commands were really executed. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (ed7b81a7a139).
